findings.counterevidence: Read the three selected bounded search scopes, not merely their complete flags. The OFR catalog (6,938 records from 1937 onward) and 7,619 saved-order text search cover the relevant presidential period. The local builder itself held only 362 texts and has no input commit or STATUS.json; it is not the full-run freeze. U.S. Code release 119-121 stops 2026-10-09, explicitly leaving five days unreflected; this supports only bounded counterevidence, not an operative predicate through cutoff. No assertion of exhaustive all-statute/all-regulation search or source-image inspection is adopted. The two USC and two eCFR hits are not held as substantive current-law leads in this dossier. The supplemental local current-law FRAGMENTS record identifies only the same EO 13350 revocation in the 10 USC 2808 note; this is corroboration, not a current predicate.
findings.earliest_end: The complete 55 FR 48099 original invokes emergency construction authority under 10 U.S.C. 2808 in accordance with its terms, makes it immediately effective, and orders transmission/publication. It supplies no date sunset or evidence of an earlier emergency cessation. Completion of a particular construction project is not an earlier end of the general authorization. EO 13350 preamble expressly revokes EO 12734 and terminates the supporting emergency; section 10 makes the effective end July 30, 2004 at 12:01 a.m. EDT, rather than July 29 signing.
findings.inventory: The sole-paragraph inventory spans the complete operative original, including immediate effect and publication/transmission. No substantive separate section or independent command was omitted. Empty overrides are appropriate; derive_inventory is not applicable to this unmodified inventory.
findings.savings: EO 13350 section 1 saves prior actions/proceedings, pre-effective-date conduct, matured rights/duties and incurred penalties. These may retain accrued construction or contract effects, not fresh emergency construction authority. Sections 2-3 amend other orders; the blocked-property continuation names EO 12722/12724 and does not independently retain this construction delegation.

findings.earliest_end: Original sections 1-3 condition Treasury transfer powers and FRBNY receipt/holding/investment/transfer duties on Treasury directions and UNSCR 778 purposes. No dated sunset or evidenced exhaustion occurs in the held original; transaction contingencies do not themselves establish an earlier order-wide end. EO 13350 preamble expressly revokes EO 12817; section 10 fixes July 30, 2004 at 12:01 a.m. EDT. No earlier amending/ending actor is listed in the bounded chain.
findings.inventory: Eight disjoint absolute source spans cover sections 1-8. They correctly separate section 2 missed by OCR, preserve all section 3 duties, include section 4 across the page break, and merge section 8 heading with (a) immediate effect and (b) transmission/publication. Definition, implementation delegation and no-private-right language are included. Preamble supplies authority/purpose but no omitted standalone command.
findings.savings: Section 4 separately provides discharge to the extent of compliant transfers, protection for historical good-faith conduct, and nonimpairment of pre-transfer rights/debts/claims. Those accrued legal consequences may remain enforceable after revocation, without granting new transfer authority. EO 13350 section 1 expressly preserves past actions and matured rights/duties; it does not revive discharged obligations. The later independent commands in EO 13350 govern its own measures. Its specific continuation of EO 12722/12724 blocked-property prohibitions does not retain fresh EO 12817 instructions or the section 3 delegation.
